    Provides deterministic real-time control, diagnostics, and machine protection for an abyssal
    subsea twin-screw multiphase booster pump handling extreme dynamic Gas Volume Fractions
    (0.0% to 98.0% GVF) under severe differential pressures up to 120.0 bar boost.

  PHYSICAL ARCHITECTURE & OPERATING PRINCIPLE:
    The machine consists of twin counter-rotating intermeshing screws configured in a double-ended
    opposed-flow layout to achieve passive hydraulic axial thrust balance. The pump operates at
    the abyssal seabed (3,000 m MSL, ambient pressure 305 bar) driven by a high-voltage subsea
    Variable Speed Drive (VSD) electric motor rated for 3.2 MW.
    
    1. Dynamic Liquid Flush Injection (0 - 98% GVF):
       Twin-screw pumps rely on a thin liquid film barrier across screw-to-screw intermesh and
       screw-to-liner radial clearances to seal internal compression chambers against backflow
       (blow-by slip). In high GVF regimes (>90% GVF) or during extended gas slugs, loss of 
       liquid film eliminates hydraulic sealing, accelerating polytropic gas heating up to 180 deg C
       and inducing catastrophic dry rubbing/thermal binding. The dynamic flush system injects
       recycled conditioned liquid condensate directly into suction and intermediate rotor chambers
       governed by closed-loop GVF feedforward and thermal feedback.

    2. Differential Pressure (120 bar) Axial Rotor Thermal Growth Compensation:
       Under 120 bar differential pressure, polytropic gas compression elevates rotor core 
       temperatures rapidly while the thick outer pressure barrel is continuously chilled by 
       2.5 deg C ocean currents. Because super duplex stainless steel rotors expand axially 
       (alpha = 13.5e-6 /K) and radially faster than the cooled casing, clearance contracts from
       a cold 280 um down towards zero. The block executes real-time finite-difference thermal
       expansion modeling, active speed/dP derating, and balance piston modulation to maintain
       a safe minimum operating clearance of >= 65 um without rotor contact.

    3. High-Pressure Mechanical Seal Barrier Fluid Acoustic Leakage Monitoring:
       Dual-pressurized cartridge mechanical seals (API Plan 53B) operate with barrier fluid 
       pressurized at P_suction + 35 bar (up to 340 bar absolute). Acoustic emission (AE) 
       piezoelectric transducers (100 kHz - 300 kHz envelope detection) mounted directly on 
       seal gland housings capture high-frequency elastic stress waves emitted during boundary
       lubrication, asperity contact, seal face vapor flashing, or micro-leakage channeling.
       Triple Modular Redundant (2oo3) acoustic signals undergo running RMS, crest factor,
       and kurtosis analysis combined with accumulator volume depletion rate (dV/dt) diagnostics.

    4. Variable Speed Drive (VSD) Hydrodynamic Anti-Stall Governor:
       Severe multiphase flow produces abrupt transitions between lightweight gas pockets 
       (rho ~ 45 kg/m3) and dense liquid slugs (rho ~ 880 kg/m3). The arrival of a dense liquid 
       plug into high-speed screws generates a monumental hydrodynamic torque spike. If unmitigated,
       the motor exceeds pull-out torque or trips on VSD overcurrent within 80 ms. The anti-stall
       governor executes feedforward dP/dt and dTorque/dt slug detection, dynamic inertia 
       compensation, rapid speed trimming, and preemptive subsea recycle choke coordination.

    5. Multivariable State-Space Model & Real-Time Model Predictive Control (MPC):
       Embedded 6-state, 4-input discrete state-space model running an active-set gradient
       descent quadratic programming optimization to simultaneously regulate differential 
       pressure, rotor-to-casing thermal clearance, liquid film thickness, and shaft mechanical
       torque under strict physical actuator constraints.

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 1.0 EMERGENCY SAFETY SHUTDOWN & SIL-3 HARDWIRED INTERLOCK EVALUATION                      *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Primary functional safety interlocks: evaluate emergency stop, overpressure, severe      *)
(* rotor thermal binding hazard, barrier fluid breach, and mechanical seal destruction.     *)

dwAlarmWord1 := 16#0000_0000;
dwAlarmWord2 := 16#0000_0000;

(* Interlock 1.1: Active-low Emergency Shutdown Relay (SIL-3) *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Asserted *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.2: System Enable Permissive Lost *)
IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Master Enable Signal Dropped *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.3: Catastrophic Overpressure (Max Differential Boost Exceeded) *)
IF (rDischargePressure_A_bar - rSuctionPressure_A_bar > rMaxAllowableDiffPressure_bar + 15.0) AND
   (rDischargePressure_B_bar - rSuctionPressure_B_bar > rMaxAllowableDiffPressure_bar + 15.0) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Extreme Differential Overpressure Trip *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.4: Extreme Discharge Temperature (Polytropic Compression Overheating) *)
IF rDischargeTemp_DegC > rMaxAllowableDischargeTemp_DegC THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Bit 3: Extreme Discharge Temperature Trip *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.5: Bearing Temperature High-High (Thermal Seizure Hazard) *)
IF (rDriveEndBearingTemp_DegC > 115.0) OR (rNonDriveEndBearingTemp_DegC > 115.0) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Bit 4: High-High Bearing Temperature Trip *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.6: Excessive Vibration (Radial Bearing Destruction Hazard) *)
IF (rDriveEndVibration_mms > 18.5) OR (rNonDriveEndVibration_mms > 18.5) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Bit 5: Extreme Bearing Housing Vibration Trip *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.7: Rotor Axial Displacement Out of Bounds (Thrust Bearing Failure) *)
IF (rRotorAxialDisplacement_mm > rMaxRotorAxialGrowthLimit_mm + 0.85) OR
   (rRotorAxialDisplacement_mm < -0.65) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Bit 6: Rotor Axial Position Proximity Trip *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.8: Barrier Fluid Circuit Depressurization (Seal Flush Loss) *)
IF rBarrierFluidPressure_bar < (rSuctionPressure_A_bar + 10.0) THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Barrier Differential Pressure Lost *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.9: Severe Mechanical Seal Acoustic Emission Spike (Seal Face Destruction) *)
IF (rDriveSealAcoustic_A_dB > 92.0) AND (rDriveSealAcoustic_B_dB > 92.0) THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Drive End Seal Face Contact Trip *)
END_IF;

IF (rNonDriveSealAcoustic_A_dB > 92.0) AND (rNonDriveSealAcoustic_B_dB > 92.0) THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Non-Drive Seal Face Contact Trip *)
END_IF;

(* Master Safety Trip Evaluation *)
IF (dwAlarmWord1 <> 16#0000_0000) OR (dwAlarmWord2 <> 16#0000_0000) THEN
    bSystemTripped := TRUE;
    bSystemRunning := FALSE;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    iState := 100; (* Direct jump to emergency bypass shutdown state *)
END_IF;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SENSOR VOTING ALGORITHMS                             *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Executes deterministic median selection with cross-channel deviation checking across     *)
(* all five critical abyssal instrument triplets. Gracefully degrades from 2oo3 to 1oo2,   *)
(* and finally to 1oo1 fail-safe before latching a measurement channel trip.                 *)

dwDegradationWord := 16#0000_0000;

(* --- 2.1 Suction Pressure 2oo3 Voting Bank (PT-101A, PT-101B, PT-101C) --- *)
rDev_Suct_AB := ABS(rSuctionPressure_A_bar - rSuctionPressure_B_bar);
rDev_Suct_BC := ABS(rSuctionPressure_B_bar - rSuctionPressure_C_bar);
rDev_Suct_CA := ABS(rSuctionPressure_C_bar - rSuctionPressure_A_bar);

bSuct_A_Healthy := (rSuctionPressure_A_bar >= 2.0) AND (rSuctionPressure_A_bar <= 250.0);
bSuct_B_Healthy := (rSuctionPressure_B_bar >= 2.0) AND (rSuctionPressure_B_bar <= 250.0);
bSuct_C_Healthy := (rSuctionPressure_C_bar >= 2.0) AND (rSuctionPressure_C_bar <= 250.0);

IF bSuct_A_Healthy AND bSuct_B_Healthy AND bSuct_C_Healthy THEN
    bSuct_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    bSuct_Failed_Trip := FALSE;
    (* Standard 2oo3 Median Selection *)
    IF ((rSuctionPressure_A_bar >= rSuctionPressure_B_bar) AND (rSuctionPressure_A_bar <= rSuctionPressure_C_bar)) OR
       ((rSuctionPressure_A_bar >= rSuctionPressure_C_bar) AND (rSuctionPressure_A_bar <= rSuctionPressure_B_bar)) THEN
        rVotedSuctionPress_bar := rSuctionPressure_A_bar;
    ELSIF ((rSuctionPressure_B_bar >= rSuctionPressure_A_bar) AND (rSuctionPressure_B_bar <= rSuctionPressure_C_bar)) OR
          ((rSuctionPressure_B_bar >= rSuctionPressure_C_bar) AND (rSuctionPressure_B_bar <= rSuctionPressure_A_bar)) THEN
        rVotedSuctionPress_bar := rSuctionPressure_B_bar;
    ELSE
        rVotedSuctionPress_bar := rSuctionPressure_C_bar;
    END_IF;
    (* Cross-channel deviation check (threshold: 4.5 bar) *)
    IF (rDev_Suct_AB > 4.5) OR (rDev_Suct_BC > 4.5) OR (rDev_Suct_CA > 4.5) THEN
        dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* Suction transmitter deviation alert *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bSuct_A_Healthy AND bSuct_B_Healthy THEN
    bSuct_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedSuctionPress_bar := (rSuctionPressure_A_bar + rSuctionPressure_B_bar) * 0.5;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0002; (* Suction degraded to 1oo2 (C failed) *)
ELSIF bSuct_B_Healthy AND bSuct_C_Healthy THEN
    bSuct_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedSuctionPress_bar := (rSuctionPressure_B_bar + rSuctionPressure_C_bar) * 0.5;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0004; (* Suction degraded to 1oo2 (A failed) *)
ELSIF bSuct_A_Healthy AND bSuct_C_Healthy THEN
    bSuct_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedSuctionPress_bar := (rSuctionPressure_A_bar + rSuctionPressure_C_bar) * 0.5;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0008; (* Suction degraded to 1oo2 (B failed) *)
ELSIF bSuct_A_Healthy THEN
    rVotedSuctionPress_bar := rSuctionPressure_A_bar;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0010; (* Suction degraded to 1oo1 (A only) *)
ELSIF bSuct_B_Healthy THEN
    rVotedSuctionPress_bar := rSuctionPressure_B_bar;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0020; (* Suction degraded to 1oo1 (B only) *)
ELSIF bSuct_C_Healthy THEN
    rVotedSuctionPress_bar := rSuctionPressure_C_bar;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0040; (* Suction degraded to 1oo1 (C only) *)
ELSE
    bSuct_Failed_Trip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0080; (* All suction pressure transmitters failed *)
END_IF;

(* --- 2.2 Discharge Pressure 2oo3 Voting Bank (PT-102A, PT-102B, PT-102C) --- *)
rDev_Disc_AB := ABS(rDischargePressure_A_bar - rDischargePressure_B_bar);
rDev_Disc_BC := ABS(rDischargePressure_B_bar - rDischargePressure_C_bar);
rDev_Disc_CA := ABS(rDischargePressure_C_bar - rDischargePressure_A_bar);

bDisc_A_Healthy := (rDischargePressure_A_bar >= 5.0) AND (rDischargePressure_A_bar <= 350.0);
bDisc_B_Healthy := (rDischargePressure_B_bar >= 5.0) AND (rDischargePressure_B_bar <= 350.0);
bDisc_C_Healthy := (rDischargePressure_C_bar >= 5.0) AND (rDischargePressure_C_bar <= 350.0);

IF bDisc_A_Healthy AND bDisc_B_Healthy AND bDisc_C_Healthy THEN
    bDisc_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    bDisc_Failed_Trip := FALSE;
    (* Standard 2oo3 Median Selection *)
    IF ((rDischargePressure_A_bar >= rDischargePressure_B_bar) AND (rDischargePressure_A_bar <= rDischargePressure_C_bar)) OR
       ((rDischargePressure_A_bar >= rDischargePressure_C_bar) AND (rDischargePressure_A_bar <= rDischargePressure_B_bar)) THEN
        rVotedDischargePress_bar := rDischargePressure_A_bar;
    ELSIF ((rDischargePressure_B_bar >= rDischargePressure_A_bar) AND (rDischargePressure_B_bar <= rDischargePressure_C_bar)) OR
          ((rDischargePressure_B_bar >= rDischargePressure_C_bar) AND (rDischargePressure_B_bar <= rDischargePressure_A_bar)) THEN
        rVotedDischargePress_bar := rDischargePressure_B_bar;
    ELSE
        rVotedDischargePress_bar := rDischargePressure_C_bar;
    END_IF;
    IF (rDev_Disc_AB > 5.5) OR (rDev_Disc_BC > 5.5) OR (rDev_Disc_CA > 5.5) THEN
        dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0080; (* Discharge transmitter deviation *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bDisc_A_Healthy AND bDisc_B_Healthy THEN
    bDisc_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedDischargePress_bar := (rDischargePressure_A_bar + rDischargePressure_B_bar) * 0.5;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0100;
ELSIF bDisc_B_Healthy AND bDisc_C_Healthy THEN
    bDisc_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedDischargePress_bar := (rDischargePressure_B_bar + rDischargePressure_C_bar) * 0.5;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0200;
ELSIF bDisc_A_Healthy AND bDisc_C_Healthy THEN
    bDisc_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedDischargePress_bar := (rDischargePressure_A_bar + rDischargePressure_C_bar) * 0.5;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0400;
ELSIF bDisc_A_Healthy THEN
    rVotedDischargePress_bar := rDischargePressure_A_bar;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0800;
ELSIF bDisc_B_Healthy THEN
    rVotedDischargePress_bar := rDischargePressure_B_bar;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_1000;
ELSIF bDisc_C_Healthy THEN
    rVotedDischargePress_bar := rDischargePressure_C_bar;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_2000;
ELSE
    bDisc_Failed_Trip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0100; (* All discharge transmitters failed *)
END_IF;

(* Synthesized Differential Pressure *)
rVotedDifferentialPress_bar := rVotedDischargePress_bar - rVotedSuctionPress_bar;

(* --- 2.3 Inlet Gas Volume Fraction (GVF) 2oo3 Voting Bank (GVF-A, GVF-B, GVF-C) --- *)
rDev_GVF_AB := ABS(rInletGVF_A_pct - rInletGVF_B_pct);
rDev_GVF_BC := ABS(rInletGVF_B_pct - rInletGVF_C_pct);
rDev_GVF_CA := ABS(rInletGVF_C_pct - rInletGVF_A_pct);

bGVF_A_Healthy := (rInletGVF_A_pct >= 0.0) AND (rInletGVF_A_pct <= 100.0);
bGVF_B_Healthy := (rInletGVF_B_pct >= 0.0) AND (rInletGVF_B_pct <= 100.0);
bGVF_C_Healthy := (rInletGVF_C_pct >= 0.0) AND (rInletGVF_C_pct <= 100.0);

IF bGVF_A_Healthy AND bGVF_B_Healthy AND bGVF_C_Healthy THEN
    bGVF_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    bGVF_Failed_Trip := FALSE;
    IF ((rInletGVF_A_pct >= rInletGVF_B_pct) AND (rInletGVF_A_pct <= rInletGVF_C_pct)) OR
       ((rInletGVF_A_pct >= rInletGVF_C_pct) AND (rInletGVF_A_pct <= rInletGVF_B_pct)) THEN
        rVotedGVF_pct := rInletGVF_A_pct;
    ELSIF ((rInletGVF_B_pct >= rInletGVF_A_pct) AND (rInletGVF_B_pct <= rInletGVF_C_pct)) OR
          ((rInletGVF_B_pct >= rInletGVF_C_pct) AND (rInletGVF_B_pct <= rInletGVF_A_pct)) THEN
        rVotedGVF_pct := rInletGVF_B_pct;
    ELSE
        rVotedGVF_pct := rInletGVF_C_pct;
    END_IF;
    IF (rDev_GVF_AB > 6.0) OR (rDev_GVF_BC > 6.0) OR (rDev_GVF_CA > 6.0) THEN
        dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_4000; (* Radiometric GVF deviation alert *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bGVF_A_Healthy AND bGVF_B_Healthy THEN
    bGVF_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedGVF_pct := (rInletGVF_A_pct + rInletGVF_B_pct) * 0.5;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_8000;
ELSIF bGVF_B_Healthy AND bGVF_C_Healthy THEN
    bGVF_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedGVF_pct := (rInletGVF_B_pct + rInletGVF_C_pct) * 0.5;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0001_0000;
ELSIF bGVF_A_Healthy AND bGVF_C_Healthy THEN
    bGVF_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedGVF_pct := (rInletGVF_A_pct + rInletGVF_C_pct) * 0.5;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0002_0000;
ELSIF bGVF_A_Healthy THEN
    rVotedGVF_pct := rInletGVF_A_pct;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0004_0000;
ELSIF bGVF_B_Healthy THEN
    rVotedGVF_pct := rInletGVF_B_pct;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0008_0000;
ELSIF bGVF_C_Healthy THEN
    rVotedGVF_pct := rInletGVF_C_pct;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0010_0000;
ELSE
    bGVF_Failed_Trip := TRUE;
    (* Fallback to worst-case safe default GVF = 95% to force maximum liquid flush *)
    rVotedGVF_pct := 95.0;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0020_0000;

(* --- 2.4 Drive-End Mechanical Seal Acoustic 2oo3 Voting Bank --- *)
rDev_DSA_AB := ABS(rDriveSealAcoustic_A_dB - rDriveSealAcoustic_B_dB);
rDev_DSA_BC := ABS(rDriveSealAcoustic_B_dB - rDriveSealAcoustic_C_dB);
rDev_DSA_CA := ABS(rDriveSealAcoustic_C_dB - rDriveSealAcoustic_A_dB);

bDSA_A_Healthy := (rDriveSealAcoustic_A_dB >= 10.0) AND (rDriveSealAcoustic_A_dB <= 120.0);
bDSA_B_Healthy := (rDriveSealAcoustic_B_dB >= 10.0) AND (rDriveSealAcoustic_B_dB <= 120.0);
bDSA_C_Healthy := (rDriveSealAcoustic_C_dB >= 10.0) AND (rDriveSealAcoustic_C_dB <= 120.0);

IF bDSA_A_Healthy AND bDSA_B_Healthy AND bDSA_C_Healthy THEN
    IF ((rDriveSealAcoustic_A_dB >= rDriveSealAcoustic_B_dB) AND (rDriveSealAcoustic_A_dB <= rDriveSealAcoustic_C_dB)) OR
       ((rDriveSealAcoustic_A_dB >= rDriveSealAcoustic_C_dB) AND (rDriveSealAcoustic_A_dB <= rDriveSealAcoustic_B_dB)) THEN
        rVotedDriveSealAcoustic_dB := rDriveSealAcoustic_A_dB;
    ELSIF ((rDriveSealAcoustic_B_dB >= rDriveSealAcoustic_A_dB) AND (rDriveSealAcoustic_B_dB <= rDriveSealAcoustic_C_dB)) OR
          ((rDriveSealAcoustic_B_dB >= rDriveSealAcoustic_C_dB) AND (rDriveSealAcoustic_B_dB <= rDriveSealAcoustic_A_dB)) THEN
        rVotedDriveSealAcoustic_dB := rDriveSealAcoustic_B_dB;
    ELSE
        rVotedDriveSealAcoustic_dB := rDriveSealAcoustic_C_dB;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Fallback to maximum healthy sensor for safety pessimism *)
    rVotedDriveSealAcoustic_dB := 45.0;
    IF bDSA_A_Healthy AND (rDriveSealAcoustic_A_dB > rVotedDriveSealAcoustic_dB) THEN rVotedDriveSealAcoustic_dB := rDriveSealAcoustic_A_dB; END_IF;
    IF bDSA_B_Healthy AND (rDriveSealAcoustic_B_dB > rVotedDriveSealAcoustic_dB) THEN rVotedDriveSealAcoustic_dB := rDriveSealAcoustic_B_dB; END_IF;
    IF bDSA_C_Healthy AND (rDriveSealAcoustic_C_dB > rVotedDriveSealAcoustic_dB) THEN rVotedDriveSealAcoustic_dB := rDriveSealAcoustic_C_dB; END_IF;
END_IF;

rDev_NDSA_CA := ABS(rNonDriveSealAcoustic_C_dB - rNonDriveSealAcoustic_A_dB);

bNDSA_A_Healthy := (rNonDriveSealAcoustic_A_dB >= 10.0) AND (rNonDriveSealAcoustic_A_dB <= 120.0);
bNDSA_B_Healthy := (rNonDriveSealAcoustic_B_dB >= 10.0) AND (rNonDriveSealAcoustic_B_dB <= 120.0);
bNDSA_C_Healthy := (rNonDriveSealAcoustic_C_dB >= 10.0) AND (rNonDriveSealAcoustic_C_dB <= 120.0);

IF bNDSA_A_Healthy AND bNDSA_B_Healthy AND bNDSA_C_Healthy THEN
    IF ((rNonDriveSealAcoustic_A_dB >= rNonDriveSealAcoustic_B_dB) AND (rNonDriveSealAcoustic_A_dB <= rNonDriveSealAcoustic_C_dB)) OR
       ((rNonDriveSealAcoustic_A_dB >= rNonDriveSealAcoustic_C_dB) AND (rNonDriveSealAcoustic_A_dB <= rNonDriveSealAcoustic_B_dB)) THEN
        rVotedNonDriveSealAcoustic_dB := rNonDriveSealAcoustic_A_dB;
    ELSIF ((rNonDriveSealAcoustic_B_dB >= rNonDriveSealAcoustic_A_dB) AND (rNonDriveSealAcoustic_B_dB <= rNonDriveSealAcoustic_C_dB)) OR
          ((rNonDriveSealAcoustic_B_dB >= rNonDriveSealAcoustic_C_dB) AND (rNonDriveSealAcoustic_B_dB <= rNonDriveSealAcoustic_A_dB)) THEN
        rVotedNonDriveSealAcoustic_dB := rNonDriveSealAcoustic_B_dB;
    ELSE
        rVotedNonDriveSealAcoustic_dB := rNonDriveSealAcoustic_C_dB;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rVotedNonDriveSealAcoustic_dB := 45.0;
    IF bNDSA_A_Healthy AND (rNonDriveSealAcoustic_A_dB > rVotedNonDriveSealAcoustic_dB) THEN rVotedNonDriveSealAcoustic_dB := rNonDriveSealAcoustic_A_dB; END_IF;
    IF bNDSA_B_Healthy AND (rNonDriveSealAcoustic_B_dB > rVotedNonDriveSealAcoustic_dB) THEN rVotedNonDriveSealAcoustic_dB := rNonDriveSealAcoustic_B_dB; END_IF;
    IF bNDSA_C_Healthy AND (rNonDriveSealAcoustic_C_dB > rVotedNonDriveSealAcoustic_dB) THEN rVotedNonDriveSealAcoustic_dB := rNonDriveSealAcoustic_C_dB; END_IF;
END_IF;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 3.0 MULTIPHASE COMPRESSION THERMODYNAMICS & VOLUMETRIC HYDRODYNAMICS                      *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Calculates real-time polytropic gas compression temperature rise, dynamic mixture        *)
(* density, twin-screw theoretical swept displacement, and internal backflow slip.           *)

(* Compute absolute pressure ratio across the twin-screw boosting chambers *)
IF rVotedSuctionPress_bar > 1.0 THEN
    rPressureRatio := rVotedDischargePress_bar / rVotedSuctionPress_bar;
ELSE
    rPressureRatio := 1.0;
END_IF;

IF rPressureRatio < 1.0 THEN
    rPressureRatio := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* Polytropic Gas Temperature Rise Model:                                                    *)
(* T_discharge_ideal = T_suction * (P_disc / P_suct) ^ ((n - 1) / n)                         *)
(* Implemented via series expansion approximation for embedded deterministic ST execution:   *)
(* (rPressureRatio ^ ((n-1)/n)) approx 1 + ((n-1)/n)*ln(rPressureRatio) + ...                *)
(* For n = 1.285, (n - 1) / n = 0.285 / 1.285 = 0.2218                                      *)


rSuctionKelvin := rSuctionTemp_DegC + 273.15;
rRatioMinus1 := (rPressureRatio - 1.0);

(* Fast convergent series for natural log: ln(x) for x near 1 to 10 *)
IF rPressureRatio <= 2.5 THEN
    rLnRatio := rRatioMinus1 - 0.5 * rRatioMinus1 * rRatioMinus1 + 0.3333 * rRatioMinus1 * rRatioMinus1 * rRatioMinus1;
ELSE
    (* Empirical log approximation for higher pressure ratios up to 10.0 *)
    rLnRatio := 0.6931 + (rPressureRatio - 2.0) / (0.5 * (rPressureRatio + 2.0));
END_IF;

(* Exponent term evaluation: exp(0.2218 * ln(rPressureRatio)) *)
rExponentTerm := 1.0 + (0.2218 * rLnRatio) + 0.5 * (0.2218 * rLnRatio) * (0.2218 * rLnRatio);
rTheoreticalKelvin := rSuctionKelvin * rExponentTerm;
rTheoreticalGasTempRise_DegC := rTheoreticalKelvin - 273.15 - rSuctionTemp_DegC;
rPolytropicGasTempRise_DegC := rTheoreticalGasTempRise_DegC * (rVotedGVF_pct / 100.0);

(* Mixture Density Estimation:                                                              *)
(* rho_mix = (1 - GVF) * rho_liquid + GVF * rho_gas                                         *)
(* Gas density from real gas law: rho_gas = (P_suct * 1e5 * MW) / (Z * R * T)              *)


rGasDensityLocal := (rVotedSuctionPress_bar * 100000.0 * c_GasMolecularWeight_kgmol) / (0.88 * c_UniversalGasConst_R * rSuctionKelvin);
IF rGasDensityLocal < 5.0 THEN rGasDensityLocal := 5.0; END_IF;
IF rGasDensityLocal > 180.0 THEN rGasDensityLocal := 180.0; END_IF;

rLiquidDensityLocal := c_StandardCondensateDensity * (1.0 - 0.0008 * (rSuctionTemp_DegC - 15.0));
rMixtureDensityLocal := ((100.0 - rVotedGVF_pct) * 0.01 * rLiquidDensityLocal) + ((rVotedGVF_pct * 0.01) * rGasDensityLocal);

(* Theoretical Swept Displacement of Twin-Screw Profile [m3/h]:                              *)
(* Q_theor = c_TheoreticalDisplacement_Lprev * Speed_rpm * (60 / 1000)                      *)


rTheorFlow_m3h := c_TheoreticalDisplacement_Lprev * rMotorShaftSpeed_rpm * 0.060;

(* Internal Slip Backflow Model (Leakage across radial and intermesh clearances):           *)
(* Q_slip = K_slip * (delta_P / mu_eff) * (Clearance ^ 3)                                   *)
(* In high GVF, effective dynamic viscosity drops by orders of magnitude, maximizing slip!   *)


rEffectiveViscosity := (1.0 - (rVotedGVF_pct * 0.01)) * 0.0018 + (rVotedGVF_pct * 0.01) * 0.000018;
IF rEffectiveViscosity < 0.000020 THEN rEffectiveViscosity := 0.000020; END_IF;

rClearanceFactor := (rCalculatedClearance_um / 280.0) * (rCalculatedClearance_um / 280.0) * (rCalculatedClearance_um / 280.0);
rSlipFlow_m3h := 0.0085 * (rVotedDifferentialPress_bar / (rEffectiveViscosity * 1000.0)) * rClearanceFactor;
IF rSlipFlow_m3h > rTheorFlow_m3h * 0.90 THEN
    rSlipFlow_m3h := rTheorFlow_m3h * 0.90;
END_IF;

(* Volumetric Efficiency Estimation [%] *)
IF rTheorFlow_m3h > 10.0 THEN
    rEstimatedVolEfficiency_pct := ((rTheorFlow_m3h - rSlipFlow_m3h) / rTheorFlow_m3h) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rEstimatedVolEfficiency_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF rEstimatedVolEfficiency_pct < 0.0 THEN rEstimatedVolEfficiency_pct := 0.0; END_IF;
IF rEstimatedVolEfficiency_pct > 100.0 THEN rEstimatedVolEfficiency_pct := 100.0; END_IF;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 4.0 120-BAR DIFFERENTIAL PRESSURE AXIAL ROTOR THERMAL GROWTH COMPENSATION                 *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Under 120 bar boost, high polytropic heat in the gas pockets heats the inner rotors      *)
(* while outer casing is refrigerated by 2.5 deg C abyssal seawater. Calculates differential *)
(* axial expansion and radial screw tip-to-liner clearance reduction. Derates speed/dP.     *)

(* Thermal model: Filtered rotor temperature tracking with dynamic heat transfer *)


(* Polytropic heat generated by internal gas compression and mechanical shearing [kW] *)
rHeatGenRate := (rMotorActivePower_kW * (1.0 - (rEstimatedVolEfficiency_pct * 0.01))) + 
                (0.045 * rVotedDifferentialPress_bar * rMotorShaftSpeed_rpm * 0.01);

(* Heat removed by dynamic liquid flush injection [kW]: Q_cool = m_dot * Cp * delta_T *)
rFlushCoolingRate := (rLiquidFlushSupplyFlow_m3h * 1000.0 / 3600.0) * 2.15 * (rEstimatedRotorTemp_DegC - rSuctionTemp_DegC);
IF rFlushCoolingRate < 0.0 THEN rFlushCoolingRate := 0.0; END_IF;

(* Heat transferred through casing liner to 2.5 deg C ocean abyss [kW] *)
rHeatLossRate := 0.85 * (rCasingWallTemp_DegC - rAmbientSeawaterTemp_DegC);

(* Lumped parameter rotor metal thermal integration *)
rNetThermalPower := rHeatGenRate - rFlushCoolingRate - rHeatLossRate;
rEstimatedRotorTemp_DegC := rEstimatedRotorTemp_DegC + (rNetThermalPower * 0.00045 * rCycleTime_sec);

(* Sanity clamping on rotor bulk temperature *)
IF rEstimatedRotorTemp_DegC < rSuctionTemp_DegC THEN rEstimatedRotorTemp_DegC := rSuctionTemp_DegC; END_IF;
IF rEstimatedRotorTemp_DegC > 220.0 THEN rEstimatedRotorTemp_DegC := 220.0; END_IF;

(* Radial and Axial Thermal Expansion Calculations *)
rThermalGradient_DegC := rEstimatedRotorTemp_DegC - rCasingWallTemp_DegC;
IF rThermalGradient_DegC < 0.0 THEN rThermalGradient_DegC := 0.0; END_IF;

(* Rotor Axial Elongation: delta_L = L_base * alpha * (T_rotor - T_ref) [mm] *)
rRotorAxialGrowth_mm := c_RotorBaseLength_mm * c_RotorAlpha * (rEstimatedRotorTemp_DegC - 15.0);
rCasingAxialGrowth_mm := c_RotorBaseLength_mm * c_CasingAlpha * (rCasingWallTemp_DegC - 15.0);
rNetAxialGrowth_mm := rRotorAxialGrowth_mm - rCasingAxialGrowth_mm;
rAxialThermalElongation_mm := rNetAxialGrowth_mm;

(* Rotor Radial Expansion of Screw Crest: delta_R = R_outer * alpha * delta_T [um] *)
rRotorRadialGrowth_um := (c_RotorOuterDiameter_mm * 0.5) * c_RotorAlpha * (rEstimatedRotorTemp_DegC - 15.0) * 1000.0;
rCasingRadialGrowth_um := (c_RotorOuterDiameter_mm * 0.5) * c_CasingAlpha * (rCasingWallTemp_DegC - 15.0) * 1000.0;
rNetClearanceReduction_um := rRotorRadialGrowth_um - rCasingRadialGrowth_um;

(* Dynamic Tip-to-Liner Radial Operating Clearance [um] *)
rCalculatedClearance_um := c_NominalColdRadialClearance_um - rNetClearanceReduction_um;

(* Clearance Binding Hazard Interlocks & Protective Derate *)
IF rCalculatedClearance_um < rMinSafeRadialClearance_um THEN
    bThermalBindingHazard := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* Rotor thermal clearance critically low *)
    (* Active dP derating factor: automatically shed boost to lower compression heating *)
    rPressureDerateFactor := (rCalculatedClearance_um / rMinSafeRadialClearance_um);
    IF rPressureDerateFactor < 0.45 THEN rPressureDerateFactor := 0.45; END_IF;
ELSE
    bThermalBindingHazard := FALSE;
    rPressureDerateFactor := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* Hard trip if clearance drops below absolute physical contact threshold (35 um) *)
IF rCalculatedClearance_um < 35.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Severe Rotor Clearance Touchdown Trip *)
END_IF;

(* Hard trip if rotor axial elongation exceeds mechanical expansion joint travel *)
IF rAxialThermalElongation_mm > rMaxRotorAxialGrowthLimit_mm THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Axial Rotor Thermal Over-Extension Trip *)
END_IF;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 5.0 HIGH-PRESSURE MECHANICAL SEAL BARRIER FLUID ACOUSTIC EMISSION MONITORING              *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Monitors dual pressurized mechanical face seals (Plan 53B) utilizing high-frequency       *)
(* ultrasonic acoustic emission (AE). Evaluates seal face boundary friction, face flashing,  *)
(* and micro-channel barrier fluid leakage rates via accumulator level decay (dV/dt).        *)

(* First-order low-pass filtering on voted ultrasonic acoustic noise [dB] *)
rDriveAcousticFilterBuf := rDriveAcousticFilterBuf + 0.12 * (rVotedDriveSealAcoustic_dB - rDriveAcousticFilterBuf);
rNonDriveAcousticFilterBuf := rNonDriveAcousticFilterBuf + 0.12 * (rVotedNonDriveSealAcoustic_dB - rNonDriveAcousticFilterBuf);

(* Crest factor calculation: Peak / RMS ratio *)
IF rDriveAcousticFilterBuf > 10.0 THEN
    rAcousticCrestFactor_DE := rVotedDriveSealAcoustic_dB / rDriveAcousticFilterBuf;
ELSE
    rAcousticCrestFactor_DE := 1.0;
END_IF;

IF rNonDriveAcousticFilterBuf > 10.0 THEN
    rAcousticCrestFactor_NDE := rVotedNonDriveSealAcoustic_dB / rNonDriveAcousticFilterBuf;
ELSE
    rAcousticCrestFactor_NDE := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* Acoustic threshold evaluation for incipient seal face contact and leakage *)
IF (rDriveAcousticFilterBuf > rAcousticLeakThreshold_dB) OR 
   (rNonDriveAcousticFilterBuf > rAcousticLeakThreshold_dB) THEN
    bSealLeakageAlarm := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0002; (* Mechanical seal acoustic emission high *)
ELSE
    bSealLeakageAlarm := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Plan 53B Accumulator Depletion Rate (dV/dt) Evaluation over 10-second sample window *)
tBarrierLeakSampleTimer(IN := NOT tBarrierLeakSampleTimer.Q, PT := T#10S);
IF tBarrierLeakSampleTimer.Q THEN
    rBarrierLevelDelta_pct := rPrevBarrierLevel_pct - rBarrierReservoirLevel_pct;
    rPrevBarrierLevel_pct := rBarrierReservoirLevel_pct;
    
    (* Conversion from % level drop over 10s to L/h barrier leakage:                         *)
    (* Assuming 50 L total bladder capacity: 1% drop = 0.5 L. 10 s rate * 360 = L/h.         *)
    IF rBarrierLevelDelta_pct > 0.0 THEN
        rBarrierFluidDepletionRate_Lph := rBarrierLevelDelta_pct * 0.50 * 360.0;
    ELSE
        rBarrierFluidDepletionRate_Lph := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Barrier fluid leakage alarm thresholds *)
IF rBarrierFluidDepletionRate_Lph > 2.50 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0004; (* Barrier fluid excessive consumption warning *)
END_IF;

IF rBarrierFluidDepletionRate_Lph > 8.00 THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Barrier fluid gross seal breach trip *)
END_IF;

(* Automated barrier intensifier makeup pump modulation *)
IF rBarrierFluidPressure_bar < (rVotedDischargePress_bar + 25.0) THEN
    rBarrierPumpDemand_pct := 100.0; (* Full makeup pump charging *)
ELSIF rBarrierFluidPressure_bar < (rVotedDischargePress_bar + 35.0) THEN
    rBarrierPumpDemand_pct := 45.0;  (* Trickle pressurization *)
ELSE
    rBarrierPumpDemand_pct := 0.0;   (* Bladder fully pressurized *)
END_IF;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 6.0 VARIABLE SPEED DRIVE (VSD) HYDRODYNAMIC ANTI-STALL & TRANSIENT SLUG GOVERNOR          *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Multiphase slugging causes instantaneous density jumps (gas: 45 kg/m3 -> liquid: 880 kg/m3).*)
(* A sudden liquid plug creates a massive hydrodynamic torque shock. Computes feedforward    *)
(* torque derivatives, detects slug impact, trims speed demand, and coordinates recycle choke.*)

(* Derivative tracking of motor torque and differential pressure *)
rTorqueDerivative_Nms := (rMotorShaftTorque_Nm - rPrevTorque_Nm) / rCycleTime_sec;
rPrevTorque_Nm := rMotorShaftTorque_Nm;

rDiffPressDerivative_bars := (rVotedDifferentialPress_bar - rPrevDiffPress_bar) / rCycleTime_sec;
rPrevDiffPress_bar := rVotedDifferentialPress_bar;

rGVFDerivative_pcts := (rVotedGVF_pct - rPrevGVF_pct) / rCycleTime_sec;
rPrevGVF_pct := rVotedGVF_pct;

(* Transient Slug Impact Detection Logic:                                                    *)
(* High negative d(GVF)/dt coupled with high positive d(Torque)/dt indicates liquid arrival.*)
IF (rTorqueDerivative_Nms > 8500.0) OR ((rGVFDerivative_pcts < -45.0) AND (rMotorShaftTorque_Nm > 14000.0)) THEN
    bLiquidSlugImpactFlag := TRUE;
    bAntiStallIntervention := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0008; (* Liquid slug impact anti-stall active *)
END_IF;

(* Anti-Stall Intervention Governor: Rapid speed shedding & bypass choke opening *)
IF bLiquidSlugImpactFlag AND bAntiStallEnable THEN
    (* Shed speed rapidly (up to 400 rpm) to decouple rotational kinetic energy *)
    rAntiStallSpeedTrim_rpm := -350.0;
    (* Preemptively crack open subsea recycle choke to divert high-density liquid plug *)
    rAntiStallChokeTrim_pct := 38.0;
    
    tAntiStallDecelTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#2S500MS);
    IF tAntiStallDecelTimer.Q THEN
        tAntiStallDecelTimer(IN := FALSE);
        bLiquidSlugImpactFlag := FALSE;
        bAntiStallIntervention := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    tAntiStallDecelTimer(IN := FALSE);
    rAntiStallSpeedTrim_rpm := 0.0;
    rAntiStallChokeTrim_pct := 0.0;
    IF NOT bGasSlugWarning THEN
        bAntiStallIntervention := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Gas Pocket Surge Detection: Sudden jump to 98% GVF causes loss of load and overspeed *)
IF (rVotedGVF_pct > 92.0) THEN
    bGasSlugWarning := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0010; (* High GVF Gas Slug Warning Active *)
ELSE
    bGasSlugWarning := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Shaft Mechanical Shear Stress Calculation [MPa]:                                 *)
(* Tau = (16 * Torque) / (pi * d_core ^ 3)                                                  *)
(* For d_core = 180 mm: pi * 0.180^3 / 16 = 0.001145 m3                                     *)
rShaftMechanicalStress_MPa := (rMotorShaftTorque_Nm / 0.001145) * 1.0E-6;
IF rShaftMechanicalStress_MPa > 165.0 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0020; (* Shaft mechanical shear stress high *)
END_IF;
IF rShaftMechanicalStress_MPa > 240.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0200;   (* Shaft mechanical yield over-stress trip *)
END_IF;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 7.0 6-STATE MULTIVARIABLE STATE-SPACE DISCRETE MODEL & REAL-TIME MPC OPTIMIZATION         *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* State-space representation of twin-screw booster pump:                                    *)
(*   x[k+1] = A * x[k] + B * u[k]                                                           *)
(*   y[k]   = C * x[k] + D * u[k]                                                           *)
(* Solves an embedded quadratic cost function via active-set gradient descent:               *)
(*   J = (x - x_ref)^T * Q * (x - x_ref) + delta_u^T * R * delta_u                           *)

(* Initialization of State-Space Matrices on First Scan *)
IF NOT bMatricesInitialized THEN
    (* Diagonal & Coupling entries for A (6x6 discrete transition matrix) *)
    A_mat[1,1] := 0.9850; A_mat[1,2] := 0.0120; A_mat[1,3] := 0.0085; A_mat[1,4] := 0.0000; A_mat[1,5] := -0.0150; A_mat[1,6] := 0.0025;
    A_mat[2,1] := 0.0080; A_mat[2,2] := 0.9750; A_mat[2,3] := 0.0000; A_mat[2,4] := 0.0000; A_mat[2,5] := 0.0000;  A_mat[2,6] := 0.0000;
    A_mat[3,1] := 0.0000; A_mat[3,2] := 0.0000; A_mat[3,3] := 0.9420; A_mat[3,4] := -0.0250;A_mat[3,5] := 0.0450;  A_mat[3,6] := 0.0180;
    A_mat[4,1] := 0.0005; A_mat[4,2] := -0.0004;A_mat[4,3] := 0.0012; A_mat[4,4] := 0.9920; A_mat[4,5] := 0.0000;  A_mat[4,6] := 0.0008;
    A_mat[5,1] := -0.0250;A_mat[5,2] := 0.0100; A_mat[5,3] := -0.0350;A_mat[5,4] := 0.0000; A_mat[5,5] := 0.8850;  A_mat[5,6] := -0.0120;
    A_mat[6,1] := 0.0000; A_mat[6,2] := 0.0000; A_mat[6,3] := 0.1550; A_mat[6,4] := 0.0000; A_mat[6,5] := -0.0850; A_mat[6,6] := 0.9150;

    (* Input Coupling Matrix B (6x4) *)
    B_mat[1,1] := -0.450; B_mat[1,2] := 0.0120; B_mat[1,3] := -0.080; B_mat[1,4] := 0.0000;
    B_mat[2,1] := -0.080; B_mat[2,2] := 0.0020; B_mat[2,3] := -0.020; B_mat[2,4] := 0.0000;
    B_mat[3,1] := 0.120;  B_mat[3,2] := 0.0650; B_mat[3,3] := -0.550; B_mat[3,4] := 0.0000;
    B_mat[4,1] := -0.002; B_mat[4,2] := 0.0008; B_mat[4,3] := -0.001; B_mat[4,4] := 0.0000;
    B_mat[5,1] := 0.850;  B_mat[5,2] := -0.0150;B_mat[5,3] := 0.050;  B_mat[5,4] := 0.1200;
    B_mat[6,1] := 0.050;  B_mat[6,2] := 1.2500; B_mat[6,3] := -2.450; B_mat[6,4] := 0.0000;

    (* Output Observation Matrix C (6x6 Identity mapping) *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
            IF iRow = iCol THEN
                C_mat[iRow, iCol] := 1.0;
            ELSE
                C_mat[iRow, iCol] := 0.0;
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Penalty Weight Matrices Q and R *)
    Q_diag[1] := 0.85;  (* Penalty on Rotor Temperature deviation *)
    Q_diag[2] := 0.20;  (* Penalty on Casing Temperature deviation *)
    Q_diag[3] := 2.50;  (* High priority: Differential Pressure tracking *)
    Q_diag[4] := 4.20;  (* Critical priority: Axial Rotor Elongation containment *)
    Q_diag[5] := 1.80;  (* Liquid film thickness preservation *)
    Q_diag[6] := 0.45;  (* Mechanical torque oscillation suppression *)

    R_diag[1] := 0.35;  (* Penalty on flush injection valve rate of movement *)
    R_diag[2] := 0.15;  (* Penalty on VSD speed acceleration moves *)
    R_diag[3] := 0.50;  (* Penalty on recycle choke valve movements *)
    R_diag[4] := 0.10;  (* Penalty on barrier intensifier moves *)

    bMatricesInitialized := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Assemble Current State Vector x_state from Sensor/Estimator Data *)
x_state[1] := rEstimatedRotorTemp_DegC;
x_state[2] := rCasingWallTemp_DegC;
x_state[3] := rVotedDifferentialPress_bar;
x_state[4] := rAxialThermalElongation_mm;
x_state[5] := rCalculatedClearance_um;
x_state[6] := rMotorShaftTorque_Nm;

(* Assemble Setpoint Reference Vector x_ref *)
x_ref[1] := 65.0;                         (* Desired steady-state rotor temp [deg C] *)
x_ref[2] := 25.0;                         (* Desired casing temperature [deg C] *)
x_ref[3] := rTargetDiffPressure_bar * rPressureDerateFactor; (* Modulated dP setpoint [bar] *)
x_ref[4] := 0.85;                         (* Nominal axial elongation target [mm] *)
x_ref[5] := 165.0;                        (* Nominal clearance target [um] *)
x_ref[6] := 11500.0;                      (* Nominal shaft torque target [N*m] *)

(* State Tracking Error Evaluation *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    x_err[iRow] := x_state[iRow] - x_ref[iRow];
END_FOR;

(* Real-Time MPC Gradient Calculation & Active-Set Optimization *)
IF bMpcGovernorEnable AND NOT bSystemTripped THEN
    bMpcInOptimization := TRUE;

    (* Compute One-Step-Ahead Predicted State: x_pred = A * x + B * u *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
        x_pred[iRow] := 0.0;
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
            x_pred[iRow] := x_pred[iRow] + A_mat[iRow, iCol] * x_state[iCol];
        END_FOR;
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
            x_pred[iRow] := x_pred[iRow] + B_mat[iRow, iCol] * u_mpc[iCol];
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Evaluate Cost Function Gradient: grad_J = B^T * Q * (x_pred - x_ref) + R * delta_u *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        grad_J[iCol] := 0.0;
        FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
            grad_J[iCol] := grad_J[iCol] + B_mat[iRow, iCol] * Q_diag[iRow] * (x_pred[iRow] - x_ref[iRow]);
        END_FOR;
        grad_J[iCol] := grad_J[iCol] + R_diag[iCol] * u_delta[iCol];
    END_FOR;

    (* Approximate Diagonal Hessian: H_diag[j] = sum_i (B[i,j]^2 * Q[i]) + R[j] *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        H_diag[iCol] := R_diag[iCol];
        FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
            H_diag[iCol] := H_diag[iCol] + (B_mat[iRow, iCol] * B_mat[iRow, iCol] * Q_diag[iRow]);
        END_FOR;
        IF H_diag[iCol] < 0.05 THEN H_diag[iCol] := 0.05; END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* Gradient Descent Optimization Steps (Newton-Raphson Active-Set Approximation) *)
    FOR iIter := 1 TO 3 DO
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
            u_delta[iCol] := -1.0 * (grad_J[iCol] / H_diag[iCol]);
            (* Rate of change hard bounds *)
            IF u_delta[iCol] > 4.5 THEN u_delta[iCol] := 4.5; END_IF;
            IF u_delta[iCol] < -4.5 THEN u_delta[iCol] := -4.5; END_IF;
            u_mpc[iCol] := u_mpc[iCol] + (rStepSize * u_delta[iCol]);
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Physical Actuator Saturation Clamping *)
    (* u[1]: Flush Flow [m3/h] (Range: 2.0 to 18.0 m3/h) *)
    IF u_mpc[1] < 2.0 THEN u_mpc[1] := 2.0; END_IF;
    IF u_mpc[1] > 18.0 THEN u_mpc[1] := 18.0; END_IF;

    (* u[2]: Shaft Speed [rpm] (Range: rMinOperatingSpeed to rMaxAllowableSpeed) *)
    IF u_mpc[2] < rMinOperatingSpeed_rpm THEN u_mpc[2] := rMinOperatingSpeed_rpm; END_IF;
    IF u_mpc[2] > rMaxAllowableSpeed_rpm THEN u_mpc[2] := rMaxAllowableSpeed_rpm; END_IF;

    (* u[3]: Recycle Choke [%] (Range: 0.0% to 100.0%) *)
    IF u_mpc[3] < 0.0 THEN u_mpc[3] := 0.0; END_IF;
    IF u_mpc[3] > 100.0 THEN u_mpc[3] := 100.0; END_IF;

    (* u[4]: Barrier Intensifier [%] (Range: 0.0% to 100.0%) *)
    IF u_mpc[4] < 0.0 THEN u_mpc[4] := 0.0; END_IF;
    IF u_mpc[4] > 100.0 THEN u_mpc[4] := 100.0; END_IF;

ELSE
    bMpcInOptimization := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* 8.0 MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM)                                                *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Comprehensive 11-stage autonomous state machine governing subsea booster pump lifecycle:   *)
(*   State 0:   DE-ENERGIZED / ABYSSAL PARKED                                                *)
(*   State 10:  STANDBY & PRE-FLIGHT 2oo3 SENSOR TMR HEALTH VERIFICATION                      *)
(*   State 20:  BARRIER FLUID PRE-PRESSURIZATION & ACOUSTIC SEAL INTEGRITY BASELINE          *)
(*   State 30:  SEAL LIQUID PRIME & SUCTION FLUSH PRE-CONDITIONING                          *)
(*   State 40:  VSD HYDRODYNAMIC SPIN-UP & ROTOR THERMAL EQUALIZATION                       *)
(*   State 50:  TRANSIENT BOOSTER COUPLING & DIFFERENTIAL PRESSURE RAMP (0 -> 120 bar)       *)
(*   State 60:  ACTIVE MULTIPHASE BOOSTING & CLOSED-LOOP GVF / MPC REGULATION                *)
(*   State 70:  HIGH GVF (>90%) THERMAL MITIGATION & INTENSIVE FLUSH BOOSTER MODE            *)
(*   State 80:  LIQUID SLUG IMPACT DAMPING & VSD HYDRODYNAMIC ANTI-STALL INTERVENTION        *)
(*   State 90:  CONTROLLED SYSTEM SHUTDOWN & EXPANSION RELIEF                               *)
(*   State 100: TRIP & EMERGENCY SUBSEA BYPASS / DEPRESSURIZATION                            *)

CASE iState OF

    0: (* STATE 0: DE-ENERGIZED / ABYSSAL PARKED *)
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        rVsdSpeedDemand_rpm := 0.0;
        rFlushValveDemand_pct := 0.0;
        rRecycleChokeDemand_pct := 100.0; (* Full open subsea bypass *)
        rBarrierPumpDemand_pct := 0.0;
        rSpeedDemandInternal_rpm := 0.0;

        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE 10: STANDBY & PRE-FLIGHT 2oo3 SENSOR TMR HEALTH VERIFICATION *)
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;

            tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#3S);
            IF tStateTimer.Q THEN

                iState := 20;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE 20: BARRIER FLUID PRE-PRESSURIZATION & ACOUSTIC SEAL INTEGRITY BASELINE *)

        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        rBarrierPumpDemand_pct := 80.0; (* Run intensifier to establish overpressure *)

        IF rBarrierFluidPressure_bar >= (rVotedSuctionPress_bar + 25.0) THEN

            IF (rVotedDriveSealAcoustic_dB < 60.0) AND (rVotedNonDriveSealAcoustic_dB < 60.0) THEN
                tBarrierCheckTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#5S);

                END_IF;

            END_IF;
        ELSE

        (* Check vibration and thermal stabilization *)

            tSpinUpTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#10S);
            IF tSpinUpTimer.Q THEN
                tSpinUpTimer(IN := FALSE);
                iState := 50; (* Transition to booster pressure ramp *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            tSpinUpTimer(IN := FALSE);
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE 50: TRANSIENT BOOSTER COUPLING & DIFFERENTIAL PRESSURE RAMP (0 -> 120 bar) *)

        bSystemReady := FALSE;

        (* Gradually close recycle choke valve to build differential pressure *)
        IF rRecycleChokeInternal_pct > 0.0 THEN
            rRecycleChokeInternal_pct := rRecycleChokeInternal_pct - (12.0 * rCycleTime_sec);
            IF rRecycleChokeInternal_pct < 0.0 THEN rRecycleChokeInternal_pct := 0.0; END_IF;
        END_IF;
        rRecycleChokeDemand_pct := rRecycleChokeInternal_pct;

        (* Ramp speed toward target operating setpoint *)
        IF rSpeedDemandInternal_rpm < rTargetRpmSetpoint_rpm THEN
            rSpeedDemandInternal_rpm := rSpeedDemandInternal_rpm + (rSpeedSlewRateLimit_rpms * rCycleTime_sec);
        END_IF;
        rVsdSpeedDemand_rpm := rSpeedDemandInternal_rpm;

        (* Dynamic liquid flush modulation based on GVF feedforward *)
        rFlushGVFFeedforward_m3h := (rVotedGVF_pct / 100.0) * 12.0;
        rTotalRequiredFlush_m3h := rFlushBaseFlow_m3h + rFlushGVFFeedforward_m3h;

        (* Check if target boost or full choke closure reached *)
        IF (rRecycleChokeInternal_pct <= 2.0) OR (rVotedDifferentialPress_bar >= (rTargetDiffPressure_bar * 0.85)) THEN
            iState := 60; (* Transition to normal multiphase boosting *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE 60: ACTIVE MULTIPHASE BOOSTING & CLOSED-LOOP GVF / MPC REGULATION *)
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bSystemReady := FALSE;

        (* Check for abnormal transient triggers *)
        IF bLiquidSlugImpactFlag THEN
            iState := 80; (* Jump to slug impact damping state *)
        ELSIF rVotedGVF_pct > 90.0 THEN
            iState := 70; (* Jump to high GVF thermal mitigation mode *)
        ELSE
            (* Closed-Loop MPC Regulation or Base PI Governor *)
            IF bMpcGovernorEnable AND bMpcInOptimization THEN
                rVsdSpeedDemand_rpm := u_mpc[2] + rAntiStallSpeedTrim_rpm;
                rFlushValveDemand_pct := (u_mpc[1] / 18.0) * 100.0;
                rRecycleChokeDemand_pct := u_mpc[3] + rAntiStallChokeTrim_pct;
            ELSE
                (* Deterministic Base Governor *)
                rVsdSpeedDemand_rpm := rTargetRpmSetpoint_rpm + rAntiStallSpeedTrim_rpm;
                rFlushGVFFeedforward_m3h := (rVotedGVF_pct / 100.0) * 11.5;
                rFlushThermalFeedback_m3h := (rThermalGradient_DegC / 80.0) * 4.5;
                rTotalRequiredFlush_m3h := rFlushBaseFlow_m3h + rFlushGVFFeedforward_m3h + rFlushThermalFeedback_m3h;
                rFlushValveDemand_pct := (rTotalRequiredFlush_m3h / 18.0) * 100.0;
                rRecycleChokeDemand_pct := 0.0 + rAntiStallChokeTrim_pct;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN

        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE 70: HIGH GVF (>90%) THERMAL MITIGATION & INTENSIVE FLUSH BOOSTER MODE *)
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bGasSlugWarning := TRUE;

        (* Maximize liquid flush injection to quench polytropic gas heat *)
        rFlushValveDemand_pct := 100.0;
        
        (* Partially open recycle choke (15-25%) to cool gas and reduce pressure ratio *)
        rRecycleChokeDemand_pct := 22.0;

        (* Derate speed to prevent excessive polytropic temperature runaway *)
        IF rVsdSpeedDemand_rpm > 1850.0 THEN
            rVsdSpeedDemand_rpm := rVsdSpeedDemand_rpm - (45.0 * rCycleTime_sec);
        END_IF;

        (* Check recovery: GVF drops below 85% and thermal gradient normalizes *)
        IF (rVotedGVF_pct < 85.0) AND (rThermalGradient_DegC < 65.0) THEN
            tSlugCooldownTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#6S);
            IF tSlugCooldownTimer.Q THEN
                tSlugCooldownTimer(IN := FALSE);
                bGasSlugWarning := FALSE;
                iState := 60; (* Return to active multiphase boosting *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            tSlugCooldownTimer(IN := FALSE);
        END_IF;

        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE 80: LIQUID SLUG IMPACT DAMPING & VSD HYDRODYNAMIC ANTI-STALL INTERVENTION *)

        rVsdSpeedDemand_rpm := rTargetRpmSetpoint_rpm - 350.0;

        rRecycleChokeDemand_pct := 40.0;

        rFlushValveDemand_pct := 50.0;

        (* Exit condition: Torque derivative decays back to stable range *)
        IF (ABS(rTorqueDerivative_Nms) < 1800.0) AND (rMotorShaftTorque_Nm < 15500.0) THEN
            tAntiStallDecelTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#3S);
            IF tAntiStallDecelTimer.Q THEN
                tAntiStallDecelTimer(IN := FALSE);
                bAntiStallIntervention := FALSE;
                bLiquidSlugImpactFlag := FALSE;
                iState := 60; (* Return to steady boosting *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            tAntiStallDecelTimer(IN := FALSE);
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE 90: CONTROLLED SYSTEM SHUTDOWN & EXPANSION RELIEF *)
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bSystemReady := FALSE;

        (* Open recycle choke to de-pressurize booster chamber *)
        IF rRecycleChokeInternal_pct < 100.0 THEN
            rRecycleChokeInternal_pct := rRecycleChokeInternal_pct + (25.0 * rCycleTime_sec);
            IF rRecycleChokeInternal_pct > 100.0 THEN rRecycleChokeInternal_pct := 100.0; END_IF;
        END_IF;
        rRecycleChokeDemand_pct := rRecycleChokeInternal_pct;

        (* Ramp speed down to zero *)
        IF rSpeedDemandInternal_rpm > 0.0 THEN
            rSpeedDemandInternal_rpm := rSpeedDemandInternal_rpm - (rSpeedSlewRateLimit_rpms * rCycleTime_sec);
            IF rSpeedDemandInternal_rpm < 0.0 THEN rSpeedDemandInternal_rpm := 0.0; END_IF;
        END_IF;
        rVsdSpeedDemand_rpm := rSpeedDemandInternal_rpm;

        (* Keep flush valve active during cooldown to prevent thermal binding *)
        rFlushValveDemand_pct := 45.0;

        IF rSpeedDemandInternal_rpm <= 5.0 THEN
            rVsdSpeedDemand_rpm := 0.0;
            bSystemRunning := FALSE;
            iState := 0; (* Parked *)
        END_IF;

    100: (* STATE 100: TRIP & EMERGENCY SUBSEA BYPASS / DEPRESSURIZATION *)
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemTripped := TRUE;
        rVsdSpeedDemand_rpm := 0.0;
        rSpeedDemandInternal_rpm := 0.0;
        rRecycleChokeDemand_pct := 100.0;  (* Immediate failsafe open bypass *)
        rFlushValveDemand_pct := 0.0;
